description: This file contains shell functions and procedures for configuring and managing QMI-based network interfaces, including initialization, setup, teardown, and error handling, specifically for use with the netifd framework in embedded Linux systems.

methods.name: proto_qmi_init_config
methods.description: Initializes QMI protocol configuration parameters with various network settings.

methods.name: proto_qmi_setup
methods.description: Sets up the QMI network interface, including device initialization, SIM card status checks, network registration, and IP configuration.

methods.name: proto_qmi_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the QMI network interface, stopping network connections and releasing resources.

methods.name: qmi_wds_stop
methods.description: Stops a specific WDS (Wireless Data Service) client session, releasing network resources.
